name: loop_engine
description: Loop-engineering control plane for AI agents. Wraps swappable PLANNER / ACTOR / EVALUATOR extension points (each a sub-workflow named via input) in a durable outer loop: resolve config (effort presets, validation) -> plan -> [act -> independent evaluate -> guard -> deterministic decision policy + guardrails -> route(accept|retry|replan|delegate|escalate|stop) -> persist bounded state] -> repeat until the objective is met or a termination condition fires. Survives actor/evaluator failures (bounded infra retries) and terminates cleanly on every path.
